BrochureContent.Content:
The two bedroom apartment is finished to the highest of standards and will make a lovely home or investment property for its new owner. Currently being used as an AirBnB it attracts families looking for affordable accommodation for 1-2 weeks at a time to be close to Ballina or Enniscrone. It would make a great long term rental property as well offering a high yield on investment.

The apartment comes with one parking space in a secure car park to the rear of The Bond Store Building. The complex is managed through The Bond Store Management Company Limited by Guarantee. This is not a regular apartment in a huge apartment block. This is a private apartment on the first floor with balcony and the benefit of two restaurants at your feet. 

Seldom does an apartment come available in this boutique complex, walking distance to all Ballina`s amenities. This one won`t be here long,
 call us today to book a viewing. Viewings are available through the Sole Selling Agents APP Kirrane Auctioneering where we don`t just list properties we sell them.
